evidence: broken.php has a deliberate syntax error (line 6: the parameter list of `function broken(` is never closed; php -l: unexpected token "{"). Name resolution is unsound under syntax errors (an error region could hide a declaration of sizeof), so the kernel skips the file (source-incomplete, "file has syntax errors") and misses the sizeof call on line 3.

`delete` is not a PHP function. Inside `namespace App`, PHP resolves the unqualified call `delete($path)` to `App\delete` and falls back to the global name only for a function that exists, so name resolution cannot claim it is the global `delete`; PHP_CodeSniffer matches the name text.
